name: cache-timer
description: Counts down to when the prompt cache expires, so you can send the next message before the whole conversation has to be cached again

skipCompactHook.title: Skip the compaction hook
skipCompactHook.description: Stops the "session.compact hook was skipped" notice by not hooking the compaction itself, the step Claude Code's Security default sends past cache-timer. Only /compact then clears the line at once, as it already does where Security default runs first; after an automatic compaction in a reply, the next request restarts the count anyway. A compaction while the session is idle, or one a plugin starts, can leave the old count until your next message. On other setups, leave it off.
